496:t_2:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Anything beyond that is between those two. Let's wait and see how it ends.」

496:t_2:16.en:
$$ミネバ$$
($$シャア$$ is trying to confront his own karma, too...)

496:t_2:17.en:
$$ミネバ$$
(Then I will fulfill my own responsibilities, so he cannot laugh at me.)

496:t_2:21.en: ～Deep-space $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$　Bridge～

496:t_2:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「...$$ネオ・ジオン$$ soldiers are surrendering to us?」

496:t_2:23.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「Yes. Our exchange with $$ギュネイ・ガス$$ appears to have had a considerable influence.」

496:t_2:24.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Many seem to belong to the so-called $$シャア・アズナブル$$ faction, including Ensign $$レズン・シュナイダー$$.」

496:t_2:25.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So quite a few understand his actions and reject $$フル・フロンタル$$'s methods.」

496:t_2:26.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「Even so, the Colonel would probably repudiate what he himself did...」

496:t_2:27.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But that does not mean we can let him throw his life away.」

496:t_2:28.en:
$$ブライト$$
「There is still any number of things we need that man to do.」

496:t_2:29.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「I agree with you on that.」

496:t_2:30.en:
$$オットー$$
「But isn't it dangerous to accept defectors when we cannot guarantee the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$'s safety...?」

496:t_2:31.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I understand what you're saying, Captain $$オットー$$.」

496:t_2:32.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「...You're concerned they might be informants.」

496:t_2:33.en:
$$ブライト$$
「What do you think, Captain $$ジンネマン$$?」

496:t_2:34.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...I suppose hatred isn't so easily erased...」

496:t_2:35.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Even when this is no time to argue over the Federation and $$ジオン$$?」

496:t_2:36.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You can say that because you are on the Federation's side, Colonel $$ブライト$$.」

496:t_2:38.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But if we do not overcome that, we will only repeat our history of war.」

496:t_2:40.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Suspicion breeds imaginary monsters... Let us consider our next steps, rather than doubt the soldiers who surrendered.」

496:t_2:41.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ティエリア$$ and $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s staff intend to improve our optical camouflage and jamming beyond their previous levels.」

496:t_2:42.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Let us review this ship's routes as well.」

496:t_2:43.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I'm counting on you, Captain $$ジンネマン$$.」

496:t_2:44.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...I apologize for speaking so rudely earlier.」

496:t_2:45.en:
$$ブライト$$
「No... I also made an insensitive remark. I apologize for that.」

496:t_2:46.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I hope we can overcome past grudges through reason, as you two have.」

496:t_2:48.en:
$$オットー$$
「Commander $$ブライト$$... What will we do next?」

496:t_2:49.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We will entrust the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$'s defense to Captain $$ジンネマン$$'s group and take the offensive.」

496:t_2:51.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our next target is $$サイド１$$, which is held by the $$クロノ$$-affiliated $$連邦軍$$.」

496:t_10:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're talking about $$ギュネイ$$...」

496:t_10:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you're happy about it, it must have produced a pretty hefty amount of $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

496:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「An incredible 200 Z, in fact! I'll add them to the team's stock.」

496:t_10:8.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$カミーユ$$... Don't tell me you...did that to me for $$Ｚチップ$$s...」

496:t_10:11.en:
$$ファ$$
「She's right. $$ギュネイ$$'s in shock.」

496:t_10:12.en:
$$クェス$$
「Oh... But I can understand how $$カミーユ$$ feels, too.」

496:t_10:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ has put us through a great deal.」

496:t_10:14.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You too, $$クェス$$ and $$マリーダ$$...!」

496:t_10:15.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I think you should just apologize for everything you've done...」

496:t_10:16.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「There's no need...! I was just searching for the best path in my own way!」

496:t_10:17.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And the answer you found was to join us, right?」
